verdict.rationale: MailerSend has a public pricing page that names a Professional plan and lets users subscribe themselves after a free trial, so self-serve plan selection without a sales call is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows per-volume tier prices, overage rates, or add-on costs such as dedicated IPs or validation credits. Missing for 10: published per-volume tier pricing, overage rates, dedicated IP add-on pricing, email validation pricing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can price the service from the public site alone — per-volume tiers, overage rates, and add-on costs (dedicated IPs, validation) published without a sales call

citations.quote: Start your free trial and get access to all Professional plan features, then subscribe to a plan when you’re ready.
